q: Weyl's inequalities for the singular values of A + B where A, B are m×n matrices state:
opts: Singular values of A+B are independent of those of A and B
exp: Weyl's inequality: σᵢ₊ⱼ₋₁(A+B) ≤ σᵢ(A) + σⱼ(B). In particular σ₁(A+B) ≤ σ₁(A) + σ₁(B) (triangle inequality for operator norm). These inequalities are fundamental in matrix perturbation theory and random matrix theory.
